title: I can't change the Power Toys default user setting to the administrator setting.

status.label: Needs focused investigation
status.detail: The Settings restart-as-administrator choice reportedly leaves PowerToys showing a non-elevated state on a per-user installation.

next_action.label: Reproduce and review proposal
next_action.reason: Settings sends a restart_elevation action, but the report does not distinguish a failed or rejected elevation from a stale UI state.

judgment.rationale: Settings sends a restart_elevation action, but the report does not distinguish a failed or rejected elevation from a stale UI state.
evidence: The report describes 0.99.1 on Windows 11 build 26220 and states PowerToys was running non-elevated.
No UAC prompt or resulting process-state details were provided.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the reported behavior and review the scoped proposal before implementation.

fix_assessment.rationale: Settings sends a restart_elevation action, but the report does not distinguish a failed or rejected elevation from a stale UI state.

proposed_fixes.title: Make restart-as-administrator report and reflect the actual elevation result
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: the restart elevation request fails, is cancelled, or the Settings state is not refreshed; the failure boundary is unknown.
plan: Reproduce on a per-user installation and observe the UAC response and runner process elevation.
Trace restart_elevation from Settings through the runner and compare the resulting process to displayed state.
Fix the verified restart or state-reporting failure and cover cancelled and successful UAC paths.
verification: Accepted elevation restarts PowerToys elevated and Settings reflects it; cancellation leaves the existing session usable.

reproduce.title: Make restart-as-administrator report and reflect the actual elevation result
prerequisites: Windows administrator account and per-user PowerToys installation
setup: Open Settings General and confirm its current elevation indicator.
steps: Choose Restart PowerToys as administrator and observe the UAC prompt.
Accept the prompt and compare the runner's actual elevation to the Settings indicator.
reproduce.expected_result: Accepting UAC restarts elevated and the displayed status agrees; cancellation does not falsely report elevation.
